title: Dispatch health (slot left by a verify run, silent workers), tier and base-hint lows, default runner and style lock lows

tasks.grade_reason: test slots and stalled workers of every plan run through Orca
tasks.objective: Backlog topics policy-followups-leftovers, plan-edit-followups and path-audit-followups (docs/plans/backlog.md), in scripts/factory-pipeline.py. (1) Released verify sessions left their tests/run-all.sh alive, holding a machine-wide test slot for hours (plans owner-policy and plan-edit). Make the verify spec that `dispatch --phase verify` writes require the session to stop the test run it started (by its own PID, never by pattern) and confirm its slot is free before it records a verdict or reports, and make `status <plan>` flag a test-slot holder whose checkout is a task worktree of the plan whose verify dispatch has already reported or been released (name the slot, PID and the stop command; read-only, never kill). (2) An Orca worker can start with an empty prompt and idle, or end its turn without sending worker_done (path-audit: about 4.5 hours). `factory-pipeline.py nudge` already finds a start prompt left unsubmitted; extend it (or status) to list a dispatch with no turn start or an ended turn without worker_done after a bounded time as STALLED with the re-dispatch advice, read-only unless --send applies to the unsubmitted case only. Read the current code first: some of this may already be fixed; report what was. Cases in tests/pipeline.test.sh with fake orca stubs and fake slot directories only. Changelog fragment changelog.d/session-lows-dispatch.md. CI runs on Linux: no test may depend on host tools of this Windows machine. The machine is short on memory: run one test command at a time with -j 1; stop your own test run before you report.
acceptance: the verify spec requires stopping the session's own test run and a free slot before the verdict
